mapper.insert: insert into member(email, password, nickname, role) values (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, nickname, role, deleted FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = 0 AND role IN ('ADMIN', '2')
SELECT id, email, password, nickname, role, deleted FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = 0 AND role IN ('ADMIN', '2', 'PENDING_ADMIN')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, email, nickname, role, reg_date AS regDate FROM member WHERE role = 'PENDING_ADMIN' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET role = 'ADMIN' WHERE id = #{id} AND role = 'PENDING_ADMIN'
UPDATE member SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND role = 'PENDING_ADMIN'
